entities.name: Michael Schumacher
entities.description: Schumacher vowed to pay back Barrichello, and later that same year returned the favour in several races to help him finish second in the standings.

entities.name: United States Grand Prix
entities.description: At the United States Grand Prix, Schumacher returned the favour, by giving Barrichello the win by 0.011 seconds.

entities.name: FIA
entities.description: The FIA banned 'team orders which interfere with the race result'.

entities.name: Drivers' Championships
entities.description: Schumacher broke Fangio's 46-year record of five Drivers' Championships by winning the drivers' title for the sixth time in 2003.
